title: Prove the sharp physical prefix range for every active tensor repetition
body:
For **every positive integer m**, the same ordered prefix of the fixed role-1256 graph has the largest absolute real or imaginary physical component. The sharp bound is

```text
M(m) = (12927/2)*2^(2m) + (36549/8)*2^(4m)
       + (51071533/256)*2^ceil(9m/2).
```

Terminal row 156140 attains this bound after its eleventh donor 103886, in chart 127, at real output address zero. This answers the active-tensor question in [PR #7725](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7725). Its one-tile result remains prior work. **No new kappa** or complete root-width reduction follows. The graph, paid routes and scalar factors are unchanged.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5834f421f2751f63c1ddb459b5c2d30a3f8a9a7b/research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5834f421f2751f63c1ddb459b5c2d30a3f8a9a7b/research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5834f421f2751f63c1ddb459b5c2d30a3f8a9a7b/research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5834f421f2751f63c1ddb459b5c2d30a3f8a9a7b/research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5834f421f2751f63c1ddb459b5c2d30a3f8a9a7b/research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range/CREDITS.md). Each chart transition is repeated on m active factors, while scalar coefficients occur once. Every real and imaginary entrance component is independently in [-1,1] on the full 9m-axis field. Inputs need not be separable tensors.

The proof derives the exact transition gain `2^ceil(m*d/2)`. For rank nine and two repetitions it is 512, not the squared one-tile gain 1024. The checker groups signed prefix coefficients by transition rank, then proves polynomial dominance for both parities. All coefficients after translation by `t=1+s` are nonnegative. This covers all required `t>=1`, hence all m, without a finite repetition sweep.

| Evidence | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Complete ordered scan | 172,414 prefixes; 9,044,092 exact coefficient products |
| All-parameter dominance | 86,838 distinct rank-mass vectors; 1,736,760 nonnegative coefficients |
| Separate backward expansion | All 448 nonzero coefficients of the winning prefix |
| Actual physical witness rows | 90 entrance charts; 360 exact tensor-histogram checks through m=4 |
| Sharp values | m=1: 51863149/8; m=2: 103416050; m=3: 3287704864; m=4: 52598313856 |

The attaining-input formula chooses each component from the signs of the exact tensor adjoint row. The finite histogram checks corroborate that formula without materializing exponential address arrays. A reduced winning coefficient is rejected in both parity certificates. The wrong multiplicative gain and odd-rank floor are also disproved.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/relay1256-tensor-prefix-range
```

Both normal and optimized commands print:

```text
PASS_RELAY1256_ALL_TENSOR_PREFIXES 172414 prefixes; all m >= 1
```

Registered normal/optimized replay, commit-byte/source-history/mode checks, export verification and read-only sealed serial replay pass. The sealed replay uses no Git and leaves all hashes and modes unchanged. Full predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44381270445/job/135073833358) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas supplied the one-tile theorem and certificate in the [source proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d88ecbf3dffa8a2386c90766829b769dd8068a1f/research/relay1256-physical-prefix-range/README.md). Ali Romman's [PR #7709](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7709) supplied the normalized prefix method and question. Clear1nsight's [PR #7704](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7704) supplied the graph and physical contract; SYLforge supplied the word. The [preimage-frame source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/notes/general-clifford-frames.tex) credits icekylinx and OpenAI assistance. Native and framework notices preserve all predecessor credit.

The graph hash is `8e7b755bd2d2d387bc3d3adfe48100985adf74775ca5acbb143170a3d16b5ccf`. The source scientific commit is `d88ecbf3dffa8a2386c90766829b769dd8068a1f`, published at `72986db329dc83b77b9e69b25396c3da6d1a94bd`. This PR starts from canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. All 23 retained files are unchanged and byte-pinned. The source graph reader, backward expansion and native interpreter are shared dependencies; no pending-source ancestry is asserted.

The result covers exact row accumulators under the stated independent-input contract. Caller correlations, numerator temporaries, paid-child interiors, rounding and complete root, stock and tape costs remain open. All five framework interfaces remain conditional. This is source-aware author checking, not blind, independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19716131).
